description: Synthetic statements of Birchline Marine Corp. (fictional) for fiscal years ending 2021-09-30, 2022-09-30, 2023-09-30. Printed in units (share counts in units); HTML style 'sec', negatives as paren, zero as '—', newest period first. 'Total current liabilities' is printed wrong in the newest period (two digits transposed). The key holds the printed value; the review must catch it (a failed check, and a footing item for a 'Total' row).
